analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($340.59) vs SMA5 ($348.79)/SMA20 ($346.41)/SMA50 ($344.49): Below, confirming short-to-mid-term bearish trend.
· Position vs SMA100 ($350.71)/SMA200 ($340.56): Below SMA100, near SMA200, indicating mid-to-long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (58.6%): Bearish pressure confirmed around the historical median.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (56.4 → 44.5): Entering oversold territory suggests potential for a bounce, but conviction for trend reversal is lacking.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.9193 → -0.1740): Continued worsening signals a strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $336.38): Approaching the lower band indicates potential for a technical rebound.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($335.51): Aligns with 20-day low, a key defense line on further decline.
· Swing resistance ($349.00): Requires surpassing SMA5/20/50; a breakout could signal a trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low ($339.08) is above the 20-day low ($335.51), suggesting potential for a Higher Low, but trend reversal is not confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.31x): Accompanied the recent decline, increasing confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis: Downtrend phase; maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and approaching the lower Bollinger Band. Consider shifting to buy on surpassing SMA100 and swing resistance ($349.00).
